answer: A payout is split so that 59% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The ivory schedule is applied in yarrow and mirror shows each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4637 identities would post 1436 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
